The '''Government District''' was a district of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The location of most government structures in Coronet, the district was also home to the [[Port Pevaria]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], the [[Drall Library]], and several museums. During the [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] for control of Corellia in the [[Galactic War]], the Government District was the site of fierce fighting between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it had become known as the '''Governmental Sector'''.
